key_insight: DeepPySR improves symbolic regression by pruning irrelevant variables during search, using Pareto-based formula selection, and stacking hierarchical symbolic layers to produce more accurate, interpretable equations.
clinical_relevance: In medical imaging and other clinical data settings, this could help discover transparent risk-factor formulas instead of relying on opaque black-box models.
method: Dynamic variable pruning to drop unhelpful features as search progresses
Exponential Pareto selection to balance accuracy and complexity more directly
Hierarchical multi-layer symbolic composition for richer equations
evidence_signal: The abstract reports tests on four Feynman benchmarks and seven biomedical/social-science datasets, with gains over PySR on tasks like heart disease (F1 0.898 vs 0.787) and body fat (R² 0.794 vs 0.702).
watch_item: Performance gains may depend on dataset quality and careful tuning, and the method still needs validation before use in high-stakes clinical workflows.
paper_title: DeepPySR -- A Symbolic Regression Framework with Dynamic Pruning, Pareto Selection, and Hierarchical Composition for Real-World Scientific Discovery
